description: Preflights a pinned Overture release and publishes privacy-minimized U.S. place candidates with address latitude/longitude only; remote extraction is blocked unless separately and explicitly authorized.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects. Accept only exact HTTPS Overture STAC paths and immutable release-scoped AWS GeoParquet asset paths discovered from the pinned collection.
retry: Retry transient STAC metadata requests with bounded backoff. Do not retry redirects, host/path drift, release mutation, schema drift, duplicate GERS IDs, quality-gate failures, or a missing large-acquisition authorization flag.
checkpoint: Pin the latest immutable STAC release and all place assets; after explicit authorization, perform one DuckDB predicate/column-pushdown extraction into a run-scoped minimized source file. Build and verify a separate release before atomically changing current.json.
idempotency: The pinned Overture release ID, ordered asset URLs and declared row counts, extraction contract version, selected source checksum, and GERS IDs identify the input snapshot.
cancellation: Abort STAC requests or interrupt DuckDB, close gzip streams, leave the previous current pointer unchanged, and retain no promoted partial release.
retention_profile: Retain pinned STAC metadata, the privacy-minimized U.S. selected source snapshot, governed normalized releases, and checksums. Do not materialize or retain global GeoParquet assets.
